adjudication.rationale: The diff adds RSS/remote importing that creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/topic_embed.rb) and `Post#cook` returns `raw` unchanged for that cook_method (app/models/post.rb). In `Jobs::PollFeed`, feed item HTML is taken from `i.content` (after `CGI.unescapeHTML(...scrub)`) and passed into `TopicEmbed.import`, which stores it as raw HTML without going through the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. The embed view renders it with `raw post.cooked` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). This is a verifiable XSS/sanitization bypass risk introduced by the change.
